recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key black and white studio portrait centered within a thin black rectangular frame, surrounded by a wide white border containing clean serif typography at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast subject against a blown-out white background
Thin geometric frame containing the organic photographic subject
Symmetrical placement of text blocks relative to the central frame
Direct eye contact through lowered sunglasses creating a focal point
coreInvariants: Thin black border around the image area
Wide white margins for text placement
High-key lighting with deep shadows in clothing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Mid-shot portrait, centered, filling approximately 70% of the inner frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes peering over the top of dark sunglasses.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top text leads to the subject's face, down through the body to the bottom title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space in the outer margins and the inner background creates a stark, airy feel.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for clothing and typography
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays in skin and hair texture
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Slightly expanded width for the header text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Roman all-caps for the primary name paired with a fluid italic for the title.
graphicDevices: Thin 1pt black rectangular stroke framing the image

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 80s serif aesthetic and proportions
Matches the calligraphic feel of the bottom text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key black and white studio portrait of a man in a dark blazer and white shirt, peering over sunglasses. Place this image inside a thin black square frame centered on a large white canvas.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered all-caps serif text in the top white margin and centered italic serif text in the bottom white margin using solid black ink.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is there a thin black frame around the photo?
Is the text centered in the margins?
Is the top text all-caps and the bottom text italic?

mustRedesign: Any logos or technical symbols in the corners
Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for pure white background without gray gradients
Ensure the thin black frame is perfectly rectangular
Verify typography is sharp and legible against the white
Confirm the subject does not break the inner frame boundary
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key B&W portrait + thin black frame + wide white margins + centered serif typography (Roman top, Italic bottom).
